title: Farm names on a hoodie
slide_intent: Make sourcing part of a wearable story so the people behind food receive visible recognition.
strategic_value: Listing farms can give Sweetgreen’s clothing a connection to its supply community.
demonstration: A person seen from behind wears a green hoodie with a short food-from-farms statement and a two-column list beneath it.
practical_value: Compare a primary statement with a secondary credit list on a garment back.

content_islands.name: Statement
content_islands.spec: Place the short yellow-green sourcing message above the list.

content_islands.name: Farm list
content_islands.spec: Arrange the smaller names in two columns on the hoodie back.

content_islands.name: Wearer and setting
content_islands.spec: Keep the wearer among plants under a sunlit structure.

reference_purposes.Application: The hoodie carries a sourcing statement and farm-name list.
reference_purposes.Expression: Small pale lettering sits within a large green garment field.
